findings.description: Quick-start entry pointed to a removed README chapter.
findings.resolution: 四语改为现有快速开始与 Wiki 入口；README 保持定位、亮点、导航职责。

findings.description: Health examples mixed business ports and management probe ports.
findings.resolution: 按正式 Compose 区分 8080 与 19900–19907，Gateway 诊断用 19902；Dockerfile 回退并不读取应用 YAML。

findings.description: Scaling advice contradicted fixed mappings and referenced a missing override.
findings.resolution: 说明没有固定 container_name 但宿主端口固定，Docker 不自动递增；移除不存在的 compose.scale.yaml 操作配方。

findings.description: Published mappings and least-privilege claims differed from configuration.
findings.resolution: 端口表从正式配置投影，业务诊断及中间件回环绑定；如实保留 Nacos/XXL-JOB root 连接与七应用库 omni_app 范围。

findings.description: Build excerpts omitted actual entrypoint/cache/retry behavior.
findings.resolution: 四语使用现行 Dockerfile 节选，保留 bash exec/JAVA_OPTS、Wrapper、实际 reactor 与前端 cache/retry；片段不冒充完整文件。

findings.description: Generic binding/priority/OAuth statements were unsupported.
findings.resolution: 逐服务区分显式占位符和 Spring 环境覆盖，说明 optional:nacos import；Compose 三家回调为 8102，未证明外部登录成功。

findings.description: Mirror recommendations and size estimates lacked current evidence.
findings.resolution: 记录现有 central mirror、cache/retry 和镜像身份要求，不推荐未经验证的公共站或保留无来源 MB 估计。

findings.description: Recovery recipes used global prune and automatic port shifts.
findings.resolution: 替换为限定项目的只读诊断、归属与实际错误核对，保持标准端口；不执行清理或系统设置变更。

findings.description: Nacos environment dump could reveal credentials.
findings.resolution: 四语禁止完整 env 过滤输出，改为允许公开的键名、地址和配置存在性；正文示例不读取真实 Secret。

findings.description: Nginx explanation omitted current dynamic DNS/security/cache behavior.
findings.resolution: 对照当前 resolver、变量 upstream、代理路径、SPA、缓存和安全头；注明仅动态代理节选。

findings.description: Artifact appendix mixed broken tables and unsupported namespace/size claims.
findings.resolution: 删除无测量身份的体积估计，明确 OMNI_IMAGE_NAMESPACE 默认 omni；附录结构完整。

findings.description: Technical facts and operations had overlapping ownership.
findings.resolution: 四语保留全部 63 个原有标题，62 段当前技术说明；完整操作、身份、预期与恢复由 Wiki/指南维护。

findings.description: Japanese/Korean assertion counts differed from the formal manifest.
findings.resolution: 四语统一现行主仓库八 seed sources、25 assertions、九目标库，且生成工程使用自身清单。

findings.description: Translated terminology and spacing needed correction.
findings.resolution: 实际逐篇核对日/韩全文，替换旧中文残留及含混措辞，保持技术标识、路径和数值准确。

findings.description: Unsafe/debug recipes were repeated in every locale.
findings.resolution: 四语 15 个技术围栏严格相同；没有可执行的全局 prune、down -v 或 Nacos env dump 配方。

findings.description: The startup graph invented global readiness dependencies.
findings.resolution: 六节点七边逐项匹配正式 depends_on；Frontend 无等待边，Gateway 只等待迁移器、Redis、Auth。

findings.description: Document acceptance could be confused with database adoption authorization.
findings.resolution: 保留 adopt-current 的指纹、seed、备份/恢复身份与精确 ADOPT 报告确认，不免除高风险写入控制；未执行接管。

findings.description: Start/stop scripts and placeholder checks were overstated.
findings.resolution: 如实区分脚本默认 full/--build、CLI lite 开关、普通 down 保留卷、Compose 非空检查与 doctor 占位符检测。

findings.description: Broker port lists contained an incorrect port.
findings.resolution: 从正式配置列出 10909、10911、10912，未发布 10910；NameServer 宿主 19876 与容器 9876 区分。

findings.description: Probe timings/configuration were treated as runtime guarantees.
findings.resolution: 数值只作为配置参数，未声称冷启动耗时、MB 大小、生产容量或上游产品无法集群。

findings.description: All four old documents incorrectly claimed explicit Redis AOF.
findings.resolution: 明确正式配置未显式启用 AOF；命名卷保留不证明每键持久化或重启恢复。

findings.description: Seed override exit zero could be misreported as all assertions passing.
findings.resolution: 注明 acceptedOverrides/WARN 与 SQL 执行失败不同、正式 Compose 默认未声明覆盖；未设置或运行覆盖。

findings.description: Generated projects could inherit full-baseline counts or prior approval.
findings.resolution: 明确主仓库对照与生成工程页首范围；保留模块裁剪标记及源变化后 unverified/旧证据失效规则。

findings.description: Source proxy/callback settings could be mistaken for external success.
findings.resolution: 记录 Auth proxy 7897、NO_PROXY 与回调 8102，仅为当前声明配置，外部 OAuth 正向成功仍 0/3。

findings.description: Japanese/Korean 502 troubleshooting had an ambiguous container antecedent.
findings.resolution: 明确检查 Frontend 与 Gateway 的状态和日志，避免误把前句 Nacos/Gateway 当作所指的两个容器。

findings.description: Executor tokens and Admin login credentials were conflated in wording.
findings.resolution: 四语明确执行器 accessToken 匹配 Admin；Admin 登录密码变更另行协调数据库与私有配置，日/韩 reactor 与投递措辞同步澄清。

findings.resolution: 删除无测量身份的体积估计，明确 OMNI_IMAGE_NAMESPACE 默认 omni；附录结构完整。

findings.description: Technical facts and operations had overlapping ownership.
findings.resolution: 四语保留全部 63 个原有标题，62 段当前技术说明；完整操作、身份、预期与恢复由 Wiki/指南维护。

findings.description: Japanese/Korean assertion counts differed from the formal manifest.
findings.resolution: 四语统一现行主仓库八 seed sources、25 assertions、九目标库，且生成工程使用自身清单。

findings.description: Translated terminology and spacing needed correction.
findings.resolution: 实际逐篇核对日/韩全文，替换旧中文残留及含混措辞，保持技术标识、路径和数值准确。

findings.description: Unsafe/debug recipes were repeated in every locale.
findings.resolution: 四语 15 个技术围栏严格相同；没有可执行的全局 prune、down -v 或 Nacos env dump 配方。

findings.description: The startup graph invented global readiness dependencies.
findings.resolution: 六节点七边逐项匹配正式 depends_on；Frontend 无等待边，Gateway 只等待迁移器、Redis、Auth。

findings.description: Document acceptance could be confused with database adoption authorization.
findings.resolution: 保留 adopt-current 的指纹、seed、备份/恢复身份与精确 ADOPT 报告确认，不免除高风险写入控制；未执行接管。

findings.description: Start/stop scripts and placeholder checks were overstated.
findings.resolution: 如实区分脚本默认 full/--build、CLI lite 开关、普通 down 保留卷、Compose 非空检查与 doctor 占位符检测。

findings.description: Broker port lists contained an incorrect port.
findings.resolution: 从正式配置列出 10909、10911、10912，未发布 10910；NameServer 宿主 19876 与容器 9876 区分。

findings.description: Probe timings/configuration were treated as runtime guarantees.
findings.resolution: 数值只作为配置参数，未声称冷启动耗时、MB 大小、生产容量或上游产品无法集群。

findings.description: All four old documents incorrectly claimed explicit Redis AOF.
findings.resolution: 明确正式配置未显式启用 AOF；命名卷保留不证明每键持久化或重启恢复。

findings.description: Seed override exit zero could be misreported as all assertions passing.
findings.resolution: 注明 acceptedOverrides/WARN 与 SQL 执行失败不同、正式 Compose 默认未声明覆盖；未设置或运行覆盖。

findings.description: Generated projects could inherit full-baseline counts or prior approval.
findings.resolution: 明确主仓库对照与生成工程页首范围；保留模块裁剪标记及源变化后 unverified/旧证据失效规则。

findings.description: Source proxy/callback settings could be mistaken for external success.
findings.resolution: 记录 Auth proxy 7897、NO_PROXY 与回调 8102，仅为当前声明配置，外部 OAuth 正向成功仍 0/3。

findings.description: Japanese/Korean 502 troubleshooting had an ambiguous container antecedent.
findings.resolution: 明确检查 Frontend 与 Gateway 的状态和日志，避免误把前句 Nacos/Gateway 当作所指的两个容器。

findings.description: Executor tokens and Admin login credentials were conflated in wording.
findings.resolution: 四语明确执行器 accessToken 匹配 Admin；Admin 登录密码变更另行协调数据库与私有配置，日/韩 reactor 与投递措辞同步澄清。
